svg.title: N+1 queries
svg.desc: Both sides load a feed of 50 posts with their authors. On the left the service fetches the posts, then makes one round trip per author, filling the grid one square at a time up to 51 queries and 160 ms. On the right one query with a join loads every author at once in 12 ms.
svg.text: Loading authors one by one costs 51 round trips. One JOIN needs 1.
